_comment: Orderly frontage demo: select the Spearmen and widen the formation six times with ]. Each frontage increment reshapes the slots; the jog-speed cap (each soldier's own jog_speed) keeps individual soldiers trotting to their new positions rather than snapping or sprinting.

blob.reason: The clip deliberately films a large formation reshape at the new pitch identity; in-transit samples fire the grid metrics (same-owner bodies pass arbitrarily close mid-re-slot by design -- intra-regiment spacing is the formation arrival's job, not steering's -- and routes cross while the grid re-deals). Measured on the new-density re-pin: median neighbour 3.28 wu while six successive frontage widenings re-deal the files.
